name: paldora
description: A box for your people: a privacy-first living scrapbook for real friends and private communities.

scripts.firebase:local:flow:test: pnpm turbo run build --filter=@paldora/firebase-functions && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,storage,functions,pubsub --project demo-paldora --config firebase.native.json 'pnpm --filter @paldora/firebase-functions test:integration'
scripts.firebase:local:dev: pnpm turbo run build --filter=@paldora/firebase-functions && firebase emulators:start --only auth,firestore,storage,functions,pubsub --project demo-paldora --config firebase.native.json
scripts.firebase:web:local:test: pnpm turbo run build --filter=@paldora/firebase-functions && FIREBASE_FUNCTIONS_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:5001 firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,storage,functions,pubsub --project demo-paldora --config firebase.native.json 'pnpm --filter @paldora/firebase-trusted seed:e2e && pnpm exec playwright test -c apps/web/e2e/firebase-local.config.ts'
scripts.firebase:native:test: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-paldora --config firebase.native.json 'pnpm --filter @paldora/firebase-native test:rules'
scripts.dev:emulators: pnpm turbo run build --filter=@paldora/firebase-functions && firebase emulators:start --only auth,firestore,storage,functions,pubsub --project demo-paldora --config firebase.native.json
